title: PHILGEPS + UNGM OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

executive_summary.source_access_notes: Official PhilGEPS public category listings and shortlisted notice abstracts were checked successfully through the external runtime after sandbox DNS failed. Official UNGM public search returned 14 unique active listings and some notice details; several later UNGM detail requests were HTTP 429 rate-limited. No login, CAPTCHA, MFA, paywall, or restricted access was bypassed.

best_opportunities.project: Website Hosting and Technical Support Services for the Encyclopedia of Philippine Art Digital Edition
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34); RFQ
best_opportunities.why_fit: Direct fit for AIStaff's website operations, hosting, technical support, integrations, and managed-service capability. The SVP RFQ, post-award document model, and email submission remain unusually accessible to a new small supplier.
best_opportunities.project_summary: One lot of website hosting and technical support for the Encyclopedia of Philippine Art Digital Edition. The official abstract remains Active and publicly links the detailed RFQ.
important_requirements: Submit the signed quotation and comply with the detailed linked RFQ/RFP specifications and terms.

Post-award documents include a valid Business/Mayor's Permit, PhilGEPS registration, notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement and signing authority, CY 2025 annual ITR, and business tax returns for at least the last six months.
Submit to glycidas.penaranda@culturalcenter.gov.ph and pmd@culturalcenter.gov.ph or the CCP Procurement Management Division by the deadline.
Public contact: Regie Zapanta Profeta, (02) 8551-0039, regie.profeta@culturalcenter.gov.ph.
risks_or_blockers: The abstract still says Delivery Period: 0 days, inconsistent with an ongoing hosting/support service; the contract term must be confirmed from the RFQ.
Hosting architecture, migration scope, traffic/storage, security, uptime SLA, backup/DR, support hours, incumbent access, and exit obligations require review before pricing.
how_we_could_qualify: AIStaff can bid directly if its business, tax, PhilGEPS, and OSS documents are current.
Use a managed hosting partner only if the RFQ requires infrastructure certifications beyond AIStaff's credentials.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Make the bid/no-bid decision today, review the linked RFQ, clarify the service term, and prepare a signed technical-commercial quotation for email submission before September 14.

best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34); RFQ
best_opportunities.why_fit: A records-management system is a direct custom-software, workflow, search, dashboard, and integration opportunity for AIStaff. The SVP path is accessible and the notice permits a new supplier if the detailed technical scope is achievable.
best_opportunities.project_summary: Phase 1 of a records management system, classified as goods, with a 15-day delivery period. The complete requirements are in an associated RFQ that was not exposed as a direct public download in the logged-out abstract.
important_requirements: Submit a signed sealed quotation manually to the RTU BAC Secretariat by September 17 at 5:00 PM.
Include a photocopy of the PhilGEPS Registration Certificate and use the current GPPB forms.
Public contact: Chona M. Halili, 0999-995-5861; BAC Secretariat office telephone (02) 8534-8267 local 5101.
risks_or_blockers: The detailed RFQ/specification was not publicly downloadable from the logged-out abstract, so users, modules, migration, hosting, security, training, acceptance criteria, and source-code/IP terms are unknown.
A 15-day delivery period is very aggressive for a custom system unless Phase 1 is narrowly scoped or an existing platform is acceptable.
Submission appears manual and sealed; travel/courier timing must be planned.
how_we_could_qualify: AIStaff can bid directly using a configurable records/workflow platform if the RFQ confirms a contained Phase 1 scope.
Provide company credentials, principal and developer portfolios, implementation plan, security controls, and a realistic acceptance schedule.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Request or collect the associated RFQ from RTU today, confirm whether the 15-day period covers deployment or full implementation, and proceed only if scope and acceptance criteria fit an existing AIStaff platform.

best_opportunities.project: Identification Management System for Senior Citizens, Persons with Disabilities, and Solo Parents
best_opportunities.procuring_entity: Municipality of Sto. Domingo, Nueva Ecija
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34); RFQ
best_opportunities.why_fit: The core requirement could align with AIStaff's custom databases, citizen-service workflows, dashboards, notifications, and integrations, and the SVP budget is suitable for a focused system.
best_opportunities.project_summary: Purchase and delivery of an identification management system for three citizen groups. The public description contains only the project name and does not expose technical specifications or submission instructions.
important_requirements: Delivery period shown in the official abstract is five days.
Public contact: Marlyn Llanera Laureta, 0967-821-9345, marlynlaureta1964@gmail.com.
PhilGEPS registration and the detailed RFQ/eligibility documents must be confirmed directly because the abstract does not state them.
risks_or_blockers: The 1:00 AM closing time is unusual and should be treated literally unless the procuring entity issues a correction.
A five-day delivery window is likely infeasible for a new custom build and may imply an off-the-shelf product, equipment, card printing, or pre-existing solution.
No public scope clarifies biometrics, ID cards/printers, migration, privacy, hosting, cybersecurity, training, warranty, or submission method.
how_we_could_qualify: Pursue only if the municipality confirms a software-led scope that can be configured from an existing AIStaff system.
Partner with an ID-card or hardware vendor if physical enrollment or printing equipment is mandatory and partnerships are allowed.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Call or email the contact immediately for the RFQ and clarify the 1:00 AM deadline, five-day delivery requirement, hardware component, data privacy/security obligations, and submission method before committing bid effort.

not_recommended.project: Various Software Subscription Services for Project TANAW - 3rd Bidding
not_recommended.reason: The SVP path and Red PhilGEPS eligibility are accessible, but the abstract contains a stale August 12, 2025 submission date that conflicts with the September 14, 2026 header, while the attached specifications are not publicly exposed. The actual subscription products may require authorized resale rather than AIStaff development.

not_recommended.project: Tourism Promotions through Strategic Media Placements in Digital Televisions
not_recommended.reason: The work requires purchased placement inventory across 30 airports and 10 seaports with 300 spots per month, not Brandee content production or digital campaign management. AIStaff does not appear to control the required nationwide digital-TV media network.

not_recommended.project: Supply and Delivery of Various ICT Equipment
not_recommended.procuring_entity: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Region V
not_recommended.reason: This is a straightforward hardware purchase for storage devices, a mouse, flash drive, and laptop. It does not require AIStaff software or AI services.

not_recommended.project: Call for External Collaboration - Support project management, research, and knowledge management activities
not_recommended.reason: This new notice is a call for an individual consultant in Switzerland, not a company procurement for AI systems, content automation, or managed services. The detail page was also HTTP 429 rate-limited during verification.

not_recommended.project: Development of Comprehensive Data Governance Frameworks for Social Protection MIS
not_recommended.reason: This is an individual-consultant assignment requiring Nigeria-specific legal, social-protection, stakeholder, and data-governance expertise across federal and state levels. It is not a realistic company-level AIStaff implementation opportunity.

The listing says September 14, but the description says proposals were due August 24 and questions by August 12. This unresolved status/deadline inconsistency, enterprise lending complexity, and separate In-Tend submission path make it unsuitable.

Also obtain the RTU Records Management System RFQ today; it is the strongest new lead but its 15-day delivery scope is not yet verifiable.

RTU: obtain the associated RFQ and confirm modules, users, records volume, migration, hosting, security, integrations, training, warranty, source-code/IP terms, and whether 15 days means deployment or full acceptance.

Aguilar: obtain the purchase request immediately if a same-day response is still possible; otherwise record it as missed rather than guessing the archiving scope.

notes: PhilGEPS count is the 105 visible first-page listings across the six requested official public category pages: 20 each in Information Technology, Consulting Services, Communication Equipment and Parts, Services, and Office Equipment, plus 5 in Advertising Agency Services.

UNGM count is 14 unique active notices returned by the official public notice search across the configured AIStaff keyword set. No new or materially updated UNGM notice met the realistic-pursuit threshold.

Official PhilGEPS abstracts were opened for each qualified lead, plausible rejected lead, and urgent carry-forward; public status, budget, method, deadline, duration, description, document-request count, and contact details were checked where shown.
The CCP abstract publicly links a Google Docs RFQ. Its link and abstract summary were referenced; no paid or restricted document was downloaded.

RTU's detailed Records Management System RFQ, Sto. Domingo's system specification, and Aguilar's purchase request were not publicly downloadable from the logged-out abstracts. Missing scope was treated as a blocker rather than inferred.
UNGM public search and several notice details were checked. Some later notice detail pages returned HTTP 429, so those notices were not promoted without verified scope.
The Samar State University notice conflicts internally: its header closes September 14, 2026, while its description instructs submission by August 12, 2025. Neither date was assumed correct.
The UNRWA loan-system notice also conflicts internally: the listing closes September 14, 2026, while its description says proposals were due August 24, 2026.
